title: Per-item result
description: What a per-item judge skill returns next to its own fields, so results-rank can combine the branches of any fan-out agent. Copied into properties.item_result of each output schema that has an item_result property.

item.description: The item judged, echoed from the slot it came from. Null for a skipped (empty) slot.

item_key.description: The stable identity key list-prepare gave this item (e.g. domain:acme.example, email:jo@acme.example). Copied unchanged. Memory, de-duplication across runs and later agents join on it. Empty only for a skipped slot.

item_label.description: How to name the item in a list, e.g. 'Acme (acme.example)'. Empty for a skipped slot.

status.description: skipped = the slot was empty; no_evidence = judged, but nothing usable was found. A failed branch is detected by the platform, not reported here.

verdict.description: The skill's own verdict word, e.g. Pursue, Research, Reject.

score.description: The skill's own score; score_scale gives its range.

source_ids.description: Ids in this skill's report.sources that back the headline.
